note: With 100% vocabulary collapse (see cross_domain_build manifests), every window is an identical constant input, so the model's prediction is constant across all sequences. The precision/recall/F1 threshold-selection can then only express 'flag everyone' regardless of whether the model's constant prediction is 'miss' (before) or 'hit' (after adaptation) -- so thresholded P/R/F1 can look identical even though the model genuinely changed. mean_raw_score (not threshold-dependent) is the reliable signal: it should swing from ~1.0 (always 'miss'/anomalous) before adaptation toward ~0.0 (always 'hit'/normal) after, since the model was fine-tuned exclusively on normal target sequences.
